No commercial UA operation without a valid UA Operator Authorisation (UOA); only UAE-based operators can hold one; a Letter of Conformity from MOIAT is needed for each UA before applying.

requirement_paraphrase: Covers UA flown for research and development, new technology flights, equipment installation, scientific and academic research; excludes goods delivery and passenger carriage. Needs a UOA and MOIAT LoC per UA; default limits daytime, VLOS, 400 ft, 25 kg; beyond that a SORA for special approval. GM allows a long-term approval for a designated area such as university premises.
applies_to: R&D and academic UA operators in UAE (relevant to prototype drone/robot testing)
